Product Overview

This listing features a high-performance austenitic-hold annealing oven, designed for maximum efficiency and reliability in demanding industrial environments. Engineered with precision, this oven achieves a peak temperature of 1362°C, ensuring optimal conditions for austenitic treatments. The spacious 1904-litre chamber provides ample capacity for large-scale operations, while the rapid heat-up time of just 68 minutes minimizes downtime and maximizes productivity.

Technical Specifications

  • Peak Temperature: 1362°C
  • Chamber Capacity: 1904 litres
  • Heat-Up Time: 68 minutes
  • Cycles Before Relining: 117 cycles
  • Heat Source: Induction
  • Pricing: Unit price determined upon acceptance

Industry Standards and Consistency

All specifications are presented according to the same six-axis criteria used across this category, ensuring direct comparability and transparency. By adhering to these rigorous standards, this oven stands out as a superior choice for professionals who demand both reliability and performance.

Conclusion

With its advanced features and adherence to industry benchmarks, this austenitic-hold annealing oven offers unparalleled value and efficiency, making it the definitive solution for your heat treatment requirements.

reviews.title: Ideal Solution for Single-Site Operations

reviews.title: Key Considerations Before Installation
reviews.text: Having operated this austenitic-hold annealing oven for an extended period, I can attest to its capabilities. Despite this, I strongly recommend this oven, provided you address this consideration upfront.

reviews.title: Induction Heating Sets This Oven Apart
reviews.text: Last season, we upgraded from an older model to this austenitic-hold annealing oven, primarily for its induction heating capability.
